title: kate-fileio: write one ending for a CR LF pair
summary: to_wire_form turns a CR LF pair in the text into one target line ending. A lone CR stays a CR. The test goes in the existing encode tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: encode.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Edit only to_wire_form. Collect the scalars. Walk them by index. When the scalar is CR and the next scalar is LF, add 1 to the index and continue. Do not push that CR. When the scalar is LF, push opts.line_ending.as_str(). Every other scalar is pushed as itself. Keep the ensure_trailing_newline check exactly as it is. It still looks at s.ends_with of LF. Do not touch encode, encode_utf16_bytes, line_col_at, or the unmappable-position walk. The test a_crlf_pair_becomes_one_ending calls encode on Rope::from_str of a, CR, LF, b. UTF-8, bom false, line ending CrLf, ensure_trailing_newline false returns the bytes a, CR, LF, b. The same text with line ending Lf returns the bytes a, LF, b. The text a, LF, b with line ending CrLf returns the bytes a, CR, LF, b. The text a, CR, b with line ending CrLf returns the bytes a, CR, b. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: encode::tests::a_crlf_pair_becomes_one_ending
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. a, CR, LF, b with a CR LF ending becomes a, CR, CR, LF, b. After the change it is a, CR, LF, b. The LF ending of that text is a, LF, b. A lone LF still becomes CR LF. A lone CR stays a CR.
